DEVELOPMENT CASE STUDY / 03

Bringing branch till data into a reporting application

OrganisationPHOENIX Medical Supplies
Project datesJanuary – December 2022
RoleContract developer; application design and implementation

THE WORK

A dedicated application for branch till reporting, discrepancies and banking reconciliation.

Historical software development experience.

The requirement

Branch till data needed to support reporting, discrepancy management and banking reconciliation in a dedicated business application.

Our contribution

We designed and implemented the application using ASP.NET Core, Blazor and Azure services, with unit-testing tools and a continuous integration and delivery environment.

What was delivered

An application for managing and reporting branch till data, including discrepancies and banking reconciliations. Its scope connected the underlying financial information with the operational tasks staff needed to perform.

Why this experience matters

Useful automation starts with understanding the records, exceptions and decisions in a business process. This project demonstrates that work in an operational reporting setting.
